description:
Your body deserves sun protection too☀️

No more sticky lotions or white cast—just  spray, rub, and go! 
The Be Bodywise Body Sunscreen Spray makes sun protection effortless. 

✨ SPF 50 PA+++ Protection – Shields your skin from UVA & UVB rays. 

🛡️ 100% Safe Formula – SunCat DE technology protects without absorbing harsh chemicals. 

🌿 Soothes & Hydrates– Glycerine calms sunburn and locks in moisture. 

⏳ Anti-Ageing Benefits – Red Algae fights photoaging for youthful skin. 

❌ No White Cast – Lightweight, quick-absorbing formula.

Step 1: Shake the bottle and keep it 1-2 inches away from your body.
Step 2: Spray generously around your body and gently massage it in.
Step 3: For best results, repeat every 2 hours.
